description: Morale rules (battle-sim.md §12). Morale is 0..1000 per man; he starts with his experience level's morale (combat.json). States fall at the thresholds (shaken, wavering, routing) and climb back only hysteresis above them. Costs are points off each man affected; lossWeight: a fallen squadmate costs everyone in the squad lossWeight x 1000 / the squad's starting size (decided 2026-11-23: 2, a squad breaks after losing about a quarter). nearby: metres within which a breaking squad shakes allies or heartens enemies. A man with no enemy within safeDistance (m) recovers recoveryPerSecond up to his starting morale; a routing man rallies at rallyAt and goes back (decided 2026-11-23). A squad breaks when more than breakShare (‰) of its men in the fight rout (decided: more than half) and re-forms when more than reformShare are back. Numbers other than the decided ones are proposals of 2026-11-23, tuned on the M3 bench.
